If you are looking to get certified in Medical Massage Therapy there is no better way to do so than with the guidance of David Morin. On this channel you can learn skills that will help to enhance your practice and extend your career. This 5 month, online comprehensive guide will leave you with 72 CE Hrs. You also have the choice of taking an optional 4-Day Live Techniques Class (28 CE Hrs.). These online massage courses focus on methods that use No Thumbs, No Oil, Clothes-On,  and Side-Lying techniques.
Group class begins on June 6th / Nov 6th or you can start right now in a self-paced course. 

Visit https://masterclass.therapyedu.net/p/medical-massage-therapy-master-class-1-360 to learn more!
